schema.$comment: inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24): HAMMOND-PROPP-THESIS-2011, figure 2.3 and its principles, quoting Propp 1968 chapter 3. Function 19 has no one-word name in the 1968 edition, so its summary is used; the initial situation (0) is not a function and is left out; typographic apostrophes are written as ASCII
schema.description: One of the 31 functions in Propp's order (1 to 8, 8a Lack, 9 to 31); the order of functions in a tale is always identical, and any function may be omitted.
enum: The first function of the donor
Provision or receipt of a magical agent
Spatial transference between two kingdoms, guidance
The initial misfortune or lack is liquidated
schema.title: Propp function of dramatis personae
